notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Update 1.01

Patch Notes:
- Fixed camera zoom-in issue when a character wins the round. 
- Fork Knights client icon changed. 
- Brightened Forest and Grill levels.

notes.title: Launch Day! And Launch Day Fixes!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! 

Big thanks to those who have supported Fork Knights on its launch day! 
We are aware of some issues that have come through into the release build and are doing our best to resolve these as soon as we can! 

Major bugs listed:

- Camera zooming into character's heads
- Game crash at the character select screen when dropping out player 3 after player 4 has joined, and then rejoining player 3.

We'll be working to get these resolved very soon!

Thanks,
Screenshock Team
